stories.title: Librarians are hosting viral ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops for people who are fed up with Big Tech
stories.simple_summary: Libraries across the country are running workshops teaching people how to avoid using AI products. Many people are signing up because they're tired of big tech companies.
stories.why_it_matters: If you want to understand how to limit AI in your life, your local library might offer free help — but this doesn't affect your daily business unless you're looking to reduce AI use.

stories.title: One fallen power line exposed a growing AI data center problem. Here’s how to fix it.
stories.simple_summary: A power line failure in Virginia showed that the big buildings where AI companies store their computers don't handle power problems well. This exposed a safety issue that needs fixing.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers and investors — it doesn't affect your business unless you rely heavily on AI services and are worried about them going down.

stories.title: I tried out OpenAI’s new AI keypad — which will be fun for some coders and slightly mystifying to everyone else
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI made a new type of keyboard tool for computer programmers that uses AI. It will be useful for some people who code but confusing to most others.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you're a computer programmer, this tool isn't made for you — nothing you need to worry about.

stories.title: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
stories.simple_summary: A new AI company led by tech investors is trying to raise $100 million. They believe AI will soon be mostly used for automating routine computer tasks instead of writing code.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it's not something that affects your business right now.

stories.title: Midjourney bought the astrology app Co-Star
stories.simple_summary: Midjourney, an AI company, bought Co-Star, a popular app that gives daily horoscopes. They're combining them together in a new way.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a business deal between companies — it won't directly change your life unless you use the Co-Star app.

stories.title: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
stories.simple_summary: A coding AI company bought another company to improve how its AI talks to people. They believe the way AI communicates with you is just as important as how smart it is.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and programmers — nothing that impacts your business directly.

stories.title: You can’t ignore Google Zero anymore
stories.simple_summary: Google used to send lots of website visitors to small websites through its search engine. That deal is breaking down, and Google is keeping more visitors on its own services instead.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have a small business website, you might be getting fewer visitors from Google search than you used to — this is worth paying attention to.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Opus 5
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released a new AI called Opus 5 that costs less money and has fewer restrictions than their previous version. It should be cheaper and easier to use.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use AI tools for your business, this gives you a cheaper option to consider — but only if you're already using Anthropic's AI products.

stories.title: Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released a new AI called Claude Opus 5. It works almost as well as their fancier model but costs less.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use AI assistants for your business, you now have a cheaper choice that still works pretty well — worth trying if you want to save money.

stories.title: Meta is making its AI chatbot more like an assistant
stories.simple_summary: Meta is adding new features to its AI chatbot so it can look at your calendar and help you plan things. It's trying to be more helpful like other AI assistants.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta's AI chatbot, it will now help you organize your schedule — a useful feature if you already use that tool for your business.

stories.title: As US weighs response to Chinese AI, industry urges against broad open-weight restrictions
stories.simple_summary: AI companies are asking the U.S. government not to restrict certain types of AI. The government is thinking about new rules for AI in response to other countries.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to big tech companies and investors — government regulations haven't affected your business yet and are still being decided.

stories.title: Bluesky’s AI assistant Attie expands into an open social research tool
stories.simple_summary: Bluesky's AI tool called Attie can now help you research news and trends across social media. It lets you ask questions and learn what people are talking about.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Bluesky or care about social media trends for your business, this free research tool could help you understand what customers are interested in.
